spans.s: कच् (I) vi. 1P (pp. कचित) To sound.
कच् (II) vt. or vi. 1U (pp. कचित) 1. To bind, त्वक्त्रं चाचकचे वरम् Bt.xiv.94; 2. to shine.
कच m. 1. Hair, अलिनीजिष्णुः कचानां चयः Bhartr.i.5; 2. a scar; 3. the hem of a garment; 4. name of a son of Bṛhaspati (See App. II.); 5. a cloud.
कचा f. A she-elephant.

काच m. 1. Glass, e.g. आकरे पद्मरागाणां जन्म काचमणेः कुतः Ud. or काचं मणिं कांचनमेकसूत्रे मुग्धा निबध्नंति किमत्र चित्रम्; 2. a loop, a swinging shelf, a string so fastened to the yoke as to support burdens; 3. an eye-disease producing dimness of sight.
कच-आचित a. having dishevelled hair, Kir.i.30.
कच-ग्रह m. seizing the hair, taking by the hair, R.iii.47, xix.31.
कच-पक्ष, -पाश, -हस्त m. thick (or ornamented) hair; (पाशः पक्षश्च हस्तश्च कलापार्थाः कचात्परे Am.).
कच-पक्ष, -पाश, -हस्त m. thick (or ornamented) hair; (पाशः पक्षश्च हस्तश्च कलापार्थाः कचात्परे Am.).
कच-पक्ष, -पाश, -हस्त m. thick (or ornamented) hair; (पाशः पक्षश्च हस्तश्च कलापार्थाः कचात्परे Am.).
कच-माल m. smoke.
काच-मल, -लवण n. black salt or soda.
कचंगन n. A free market.
कचंगल m. The ocean.
कचाकचि ind. Hair against hair, i.e. pulling each other’s hair.
कचाटुर m. The दात्यूह bird.
कच्चर a. (f. रा) 1. Bad, dirty; 2. vile, wicked.
कच्चर a. (f. रा) 1. Bad, dirty; 2. vile, wicked.
कच्चित् ind. A particle- (1) of interrogation (often implying ‘I hope,’ or ‘I hope not’), e.g. आपाद्यते न व्ययमंतरायैः कच्चिन्महर्षेस्त्रिविधं तपस्तत् R.v.5, 6; (2) of joy; (3) of auspiciousness.
कच्छ (I) m.n. The hem or end of a garment.

कच्छ (II) m. 1. A bank, any ground bordering on water, स्वच्छंदोच्छलदच्छकच्छकुहरच्छातेतरांबुच्छटामूर्छन्मोहमहर्षिहर्षविहितस्नाना K.Pr.i.; 2. a marsh, a morass; 3. a particular part of the tortoise; 4. a particular part of a ship.
कच्छटिका f. The end of (a lower garment gathered) up behind and tucked into the waistband.
कच्छ-प m. (fem. पी) 1. a turtle, a tortoise, केशव धृतकच्छपरूप जय जगदीश हरे Git.G.i., M.i.44, xii.42; 2. an attitude in wrestling; 3. one of the nine treasures of Kubera; 4. (f.) a kind of lute.
कच्छ-भू f. marshy ground, a morass.
कच्छ-अंत m. the border of a lake or stream.
कच्छटिका f. The end of (a lower garment gathered) up behind and tucked into the waistband.
कच्छटिका f. The end of (a lower garment gathered) up behind and tucked into the waistband.
कच्छटिका f. The end of (a lower garment gathered) up behind and tucked into the waistband.
कच्छु(च्छू) f. Itch, scab.
कच्छु(च्छू) f. Itch, scab.
कच्छुर a. (f. रा) 1. Scabby; 2. unchaste, libidinous.
कच्छुर a. (f. रा) 1. Scabby; 2. unchaste, libidinous.
काच-घटी f. a glass ewer.
काच-भाजन n. a glass vessel.
काच-मणि m. crystal, quartz, Sant.S.i.12.
काच-मल, -लवण n. black salt or soda.
काचन n. A string or tape which ties a parcel or bundle of papers or the leaves of a manuscript.
काचन n. A string or tape which ties a parcel or bundle of papers or the leaves of a manuscript.
काचनकिन् m. A manuscript.
काचूक m. 1. A cock; 2. the Chakravāka bird.
